webster.text: Long; extended to a great length; minute in narration or argument; applied only to discourses, speeches and writings; as a prolix oration; a prolix poem; a prolix sermon.

example.quote: I have pursued it in a manner new, and I have found it necessary to be somewhat prolix, to illustrate the point I had in view.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter X, Jan. 7, 1788
